messages:
mira: heads-up — PR 9123 landed to canary (5%). I'm seeing a memory surge on longseq runs, p95 mem went from ~6.2GB -> 8.1GB. need a quick 2nd LGTM or a revert. bench link: https://bench.internal/runs/9123 :eyes:
bench-bot: auto-bench report for run 9123:
  Summary: longseq workload, seq_len=4k, concurrency=8
  before (main): p95_mem=6.2GB, p95_lat=72ms, throughput=1.0x
  after (canary):  p95_mem=8.1GB (+30%), p95_lat=75ms (+4%), throughput=0.98x
  Attached: heap-profile, alloc-heatmap (links)
mira: repro steps are in the run page. I suspect prefetch window change in alloc-scheduler patch — it increased per-shard prefetch from 256->512 tokens.
alex: can confirm locally on a small canary sim — mem curve spikes when horizon grows. attaching a tiny graph.
sam: whats the canary traffic %? any errors?
mira: 5% traffic, no errors surfaced, just higher mem and a few OOM-risk alerts from SRE smoke checks.
tj: if it's the prefetch window, quick mitigation is to revert that config or lower it to 256. which is faster? revert or hotpatch?
mira: hotpatch preferred if we can flip config in config-service. revert would require full PR rollback + merge window.
sophia: impact on tail latency seems small per bench-bot (+3ms) but mem increase is concerning for consolidation on smaller instances. want to avoid broad revert if a smaller config tweak suffices.
pat: I'm ok to lgtm a config-hotfix if benchmark shows mem back to ~6.5GB. can you run a patched canary at 5% with prefetch=256?
mira: running now — kicking off quick smoke: `./scripts/bench-canary --run 9123 --override prefetch_tokens=256 --pct 5`
bench-bot: quick-run 9123-aux started. expect ~10m. will post summary when done.
alex: i'll queue a quick mem-only run from my laptop too and watch heap profile.
sam: do we need SRE oncall in the loop? they already sent a low-priority alert but no pager yet.
mira: SRE aware. pinged on the incident channel.
bench-bot: quick-run results for 9123-aux:
  patched (prefetch=256): p95_mem=6.4GB (-21%), p95_lat=73ms (+1ms), throughput=0.995x
  artifacts: heap-profile-reduced, heatmap-reduced
sophia: that looks good. can we hold merge for one more small-run at 10% just to be safe?
mira: can do — spinning 10% now, ETA 12m.
tj: if 10% is clean, i can do hotpatch approval and flip config via config-service, then we can merge PR 9123.
pat: sounds good to me. alex — any objections?
alex: no objections, i can LGTM once the 10% run is green. :thumbsup:
mira: 10% run finished — results:
  p95_mem=6.5GB, p95_lat=74ms, no new OOMs in the window.
pat: ok i'm marking approval in GH for the hotpatch plan.
alex: LGTM on PR 9123 contingent on hotpatch being rolled within the hour.
mira: rolling hotpatch now: `config-service set inference.prefetch_tokens 256 --env canary --message "temp reduce prefetch after mem surge"`
bench-bot: config change applied to canary. verifying...
bench-bot: verification done — mem stable on subsequent sampling.
sam: great job triaging. i'll follow up with a short postmortem note on the rollout doc and tag SRE.
mira: thanks all — i'll leave the PR open for merge-on-green once the hotpatch is confirmed in prod canary. ping me if you want to re-run any extra benches. :shipit:
pat: noted, will approve merge after we see a full hour of clean canary metrics.
